name: Relic plate
description:
The ground a ruins find is shown on: a rim, a dark panel, and an old light bleeding out of the middle. Every find composes this via `use`, so the hundred-odd of them share one definition and the plate can be lifted off in one line — the `glyph` variant each of them declares removes this part and nothing else, which is what an unmet collection entry shows. The `curse` variant swaps gold for arcane, the two colours the ruins outcome already switches between.

The light is kept low on purpose. It pools exactly where the find is drawn, so every stop it gains is contrast the find loses against its own ground — measured, `scripts/readability.ts --app ss` moves the roster's median from 8.0% of the badge lit to 10.6% when the middle goes from 0.42 to 0.18, and the one find that was wholly lost on the plate (`ss.relic.bramble`) comes back. It is light a hundred badges have to be read through, not a light of its own.

curse.description: What the ruins hand you when the trespass is answered instead of rewarded. Same plate, arcane light.
